english.title: Fishing vessel owner fail to prepare and deliver account of wages under a fisherman's work agreement to fisherman
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), failed to ensure that an account of the wages of a fisherman, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), or other remuneration under a fisherman's work agreement was prepared and delivered to

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

periodically during the term of the fisherman's work agreement, at intervals not exceeding one month and within one month of the date on which the agreement terminated
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(3) and 29(3) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
